task.title: M0: core Snapshot types, partial-snapshot merge, and round-trip test
task.description:
Define the snapshot contract from docs/design.md as TypeScript types in packages/core and implement the merge of partial snapshots that the adapter registry will rely on. The Snapshot type covers repo, repoId, origin, sha, ref, analyzedAt, toolVersion, languages, files, functions, modules, edges, and coupling, with modules[].kind in dir|package|namespace|crate and edges[].level in file|module. Merge combines several Partial<Snapshot> results into one, unioning array sections and merging per-file records by path so that a size pass and a history pass for the same file end up in one record.

Acceptance criteria:
- packages/core exports Snapshot and all nested types matching the design's snapshot format exactly.
- mergeSnapshots(parts: Partial<Snapshot>[]) returns a complete Snapshot; files with the same path are merged field-wise, and languages maps are unioned.
- Conflicting scalar fields (for example two different loc values for one path) are resolved deterministically and the rule is documented.
- A round-trip test serializes a sample snapshot to JSON, gzips it, reads it back, and asserts deep equality.
- Tests cover merging two partials with overlapping files and with disjoint files.
